notes: Adds two selectable DRP initialization methods: Insert Position on Chart or First Position from GNSS.
After initialization, DRP is propagated only from Heading + Speed + delta time; GNSS remains an independent reference/comparison source.
Adds resizable live SHOW MAP windows for DRP Calculated Position and GNSS Position with selectable map layers.
Retains dynamic 500 m four-reference-point grids and pre-creates the next fixed grid ahead before leaving the active grid.
Retains live Heading, GNSS, Fusion and OBD/Log Speed status plus DRP/GNSS/Fusion coordinate comparison.
